title: From physics to products
summary: The Work Passport begins in August 2017, after the PhD chapter. A transition into industry led to the Physics Project Manager role at Hawkes Learning (November 2017–January 2018), coordinating physics courseware development. August is the archive boundary, not a claimed employment start date.

title: Antennas, arrays & leadership
summary: Principal RF and microwave engineering followed by hardware engineering management: computational electromagnetics, additive antennas, phased arrays, RAPTR, SEWIP and leadership of a 16-person engineering group.

title: Systems at mission scale
summary: Boulder has remained my Northrop Grumman career base since September 2021. I led systems engineering for OPIR ground processing and relay ground stations, including multidisciplinary integration and engineering leadership. My role later evolved from Systems Engineering Manager to Senior Staff Engineer, Systems / Lead Systems Engineer, without a career-base move to Aurora.
